{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# The values are in format '1,234.56' — need to remove commas
print("Converting revenue from string to float...")
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
# QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Refunded orders: status == 'refunded'
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Keep only completed orders and exclude QA and refunded
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]
print(f"Number of completed orders (after filtering): {len(completed_orders)}")

# Check channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(completed_orders['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(completed_orders.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
